value.message: Town of Oakville runs Learn to Swim for Preschool levels, with fall registration having opened Aug 11 at 7am - their site says, but no day, time or price is posted yet. YMCA of Oakville also offers Preschool Swim (3-5 yrs, Splashers-Jumpers) and Goldfish Swim School has ongoing weekly lessons, Semi-Private $63.50/lesson for ages 3-12 - I couldn't get into their pages today for more details. I'll keep watching and text you when more comes up.
